changes: 18-coin support: adds Bellscoin, Bitcoin Cash, Bonkcoin, Catcoin, Dash, DigiByte, Dingocoin, Flopcoin, Junkcoin, Luckycoin, Ravencoin and TrumPOW to the existing six assets.
Recovery: offline recovery and compatible JSON/key exports for every supported coin; existing paths and backups remain compatible. Komodo recovery stays PEP/SHIC only.

Legacy assets: Bonkcoin, Catcoin, Flopcoin, Junkcoin and Luckycoin remain hidden until enabled in Settings and connected to a user-supplied, tested secure Electrum server. No default servers are provided for these five.
Connections: adds the Bellscoin HTTPS adapter, chain-specific identity checks and verified defaults/fallbacks where available. Custom servers stay pinned; broadcasts are not automatically retried.
Fee safeguards: all coins now warn above $5 USD and block above $100. Notices stay hidden below the thresholds; a known fee above $100 cannot be overridden.
Missing prices: only an unavailable fresh USD price exposes a separate, unchecked one-transaction acknowledgment. It waives the dollar comparison, never network-fee checks or coin-denominated caps.
Automatic fees: new assets use read-only size-based estimates and chain-specific fee, dust and maturity rules. PEP/DOGE/SHIC/WHT retain their existing fixed-fee controls.
Balance updates: reduces unnecessary screen rebuilds and cache writes while retaining live deposit notifications, four-second fallback polling and fresh-observation checks.

Price reliability: refreshes before expiry and preserves valid coin/USDT quotes independently during outages. After five minutes, saved display prices show a persistent Last known age in minutes, hours, days or months. Saved prices never authorize transaction-fee checks.

Interface: alphabetical coin lists, new coin logos, verified pricing where available, supported activity explorer links, and the tagline Your Keys. Your Coins. New wallets still start with no assets selected.

Asset screen: tap a coin on Overview for a larger, raised logo and asset name, centered number-only balance and estimated value, plus direct Receive/Send controls. Live updates, privacy masking, wallet locking and saved-price ages remain active.

Receive: once selected, the coin stays on its own screen without other asset buttons. A left-aligned Overview link exits the screen; the selected asset is centered. The full Previous / Address number / Next row sits below the unchanged-size QR code. Private-key and Komodo sweep actions share the borderless glow style.
Compact layout: removes redundant Overview and Receive spacing to avoid unnecessary scrolling. Small screens, longer lists and extra notices remain scrollable; touch targets are preserved.

Consistent controls: Create or restore wallet, Information, recovery utilities and sweep review actions use the shared borderless glow style. Create/Restore tabs are compact; final transaction approvals and destructive controls remain visually distinct.

Activity: hides coins with no recorded transactions while retaining zero-balance history and submitted or uncertain sends. New history appears automatically, with separate loading, offline and empty-history states.

Documentation and tests: updated README, chain-validation notes and third-party notices; expanded recovery, signing, fee, network-isolation and Android coverage. Wallet/packaging CI now allows 45 minutes.

Verification: local build, lint, signing-identity, exact bundled-source and targeted browser checks passed, including all 18 asset screens. The Send-picker CI test now explicitly advances its paused clock after reload and still verifies every expected balance. Release PR checks must pass before publication. Funded testing remains pending for the newest assets; this is not an independent audit.
